verdict.rationale: Bolna documents post-call extractions configured per agent through an API that creates extraction categories (docs-1). The Analytics tab configures webhooks, call summaries and extractions to push data to a CRM from every call (docs-32), with optional call summaries (docs-2) and raw execution data in call history (docs-34). Missing for 10: detail on extraction schemas (outcomes, entities, dispositions as typed fields), webhook payload format and delivery guarantees, an API endpoint for fetching extracted data per call, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
